name: tax identification number
note: Portugal's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the Tax and Customs Authority allocates individuals their tax identification number, a single number for every legal effect with no expiry; nine sequential digits with a control digit (its rule isn't given), individuals' starting with 1 or 2 (3 not yet allocated; 45 for non-residents only taxed at source, not modelled). Individuals get one automatically. Read as given on application, to anyone (residents and non-residents both hold one). No fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Portugal: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: The Tax and Customs Authority is the entity competent to allocate a tax identification number for individuals. ... The structure of the numbering System consists by 9 sequential digits with a control digit. ... For individuals: 1xx xxx xxx 2xx xxx xxx 3xx xxx xxx (not allocated yet)
